title: Installed D4 Audit Policy Manifest
description: Hash-pinned policy bundle for all D4 lanes. This project-side manifest is not a trust anchor: the receiver must rehash the named files from the actually installed claude-roblox-dev-docs-creator skill root, recompile the built-in lane command set, and compare the canonical digest. A project copy, arbitrary check IDs, or arbitrary commands cannot authorize D4.

installedSkillRoot.description: Informational absolute installed-skill root used when the manifest was compiled. The receiver resolves its own installed skill root and must not trust this string.

sourceComponents.description: Lexicographically path-sorted exact closure of SKILL.md, every installed references/*.md file, every installed checklists/*.md file, templates/d4_findings.md, scripts/validate_d5_acceptance.py, and scripts/validate_lifecycle_transition.py. Paths are semantically unique. Receiver derives this fixed set from its installed skill root and rejects missing, duplicate, extra, reordered, or hash-mismatched components; any policy-document or fixed-validator edit forces a new audit.

promptCompilation.description: The validator rebuilds the complete orchestrator-submitted payload byte-for-byte from a built-in safety contract, the LF-normalized bytes of SKILL.md plus every references/*.md and checklists/*.md component in lexicographic path order, the findings template, and canonical JSON of requestCore. It excludes the outer request and fullPromptArtifact, avoiding a hash cycle, and does not claim provider-internal implicit frames. The stored payload hash must equal this output and the trusted authority's actual submitted-payload hash.

sourceTreePolicy.description: TREE exact policy. Snapshot source root resolves to revision.snapshotRoot exactly, has no excluded path (including .git), and every member must be an independently copied link-count-1 regular file with a unique OS identity disjoint from canonical/staging source. Commit source uses pinned Git object enumeration, which exposes tracked blobs rather than repository metadata. SOURCE-STATE rehashes snapshot gitStatusEvidence or records pinned-Git state; REVISION/TREE remain gate-critical proof. Curated alternate roots, hidden extra bytes, aliases/hardlinks, and null Git for commit are invalid.

preflightCommands.description: Stage-independent exact SOURCE-STATE/REVISION/TREE assembly set. Every argv starts with pinned Python fixedArgs and sanitized d4_preflight.py. Git is an explicit pin or literal none; commit rejects none. Script verifies --source-root equals resolved snapshotRoot or exact-object repository. shell/PATH/caller commands forbidden.

compiledPolicySha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({policyVersion, sourceComponents sorted by path, promptCompilation, sourceTreePolicy, preflightCommands sorted by checkId, lanePolicies sorted by auditTrack, denyCategories}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).

path.description: Fixed POSIX path relative to the installed skill root. role and auditTrack must match the installed compiler's fixed mapping.

sourceComponent.description: Semantic validation rederives exact role/auditTrack from path; only the three lane-owned checklist paths carry a non-null auditTrack.

requiredCheckIds.description: Catalog union for this lane. The applicable subset is derived only from candidate ID: D4-CAND selects applicability all+initial; P0-CAND selects all+post-p0. request.mode never controls applicability.

requiredCommands.description: Exact command catalog compiled from installed sources for this lane. Its checkId set equals requiredCheckIds; capsule/request/attestation/provenance exact-cover only the candidate-derived applicable subset. argv runs with shell=false and policy scripts come from the immutable _policy_runtime copy, never the installed skill root.

argv.description: Exact absolute argv after the installed-policy compiler resolves Python, skill root, sanitized root, PREFIX, and project paths. No shell parsing is permitted.
